_comment: Copy to .claude/routing.json and edit. `claude` uses the Agent tool's model aliases (haiku/sonnet/opus) -- these always resolve to Anthropic's current generation, so this block never goes stale. `codex`/`antigravity` need YOUR actual model names filled in once you've used them; leave blank until then rather than guessing. Unlike `claude`, these two are never spawned or model-selected by Claude itself -- the real user always runs their own CLI and picks its model themselves (Claude Code's own auto-mode classifier blocks Claude from spawning any process with the flag that skips its permission prompts, so this is structural, not a missing feature). to-tickets only reads these values to *mention* a suggested model as a hint when dispatching a ticket to that CLI -- never to enforce or forward one. The `trivial` tier is never looked up any more (to-tickets implements those directly instead of dispatching) -- left here so an old routing.json doesn't need editing, not because anything reads it. `delegates` is the list of coding agents actually set up for this project -- to-tickets step 6.1 skips asking who implements a ticket when this has only one entry, and only offers the entries listed here otherwise. `/init-agent` asks once at setup and writes this list; edit it by hand any time afterward (e.g. add "antigravity" once you've actually filled in its model names below) -- to-tickets reads it fresh before every dispatch, no reinstall needed.
